Hello,

I’m looking to rent a flat-panel mobile C-arm for an outpatient vascular procedure suite in the New York City area. Could you send me a quote?

Specifically, I’d like to know:

Available flat-panel models and monthly rates for 3-month and 12-month terms
Whether service and repairs are included for the full term
Delivery, installation, and pickup fees
Pricing for lead shielding and accessories such as a table or injector
Earliest available delivery date

Please let me know if you need the facility address or any other details to prepare the quote.

Thank you,

Eric Berkowitz
Community Vascular
